messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: autopage triggered: metrics-ingest-service > missing scrape windows > 5m, kafka-consumer-lag > 100k for partition group 'ingest-main' — paging oncall.

jamie: acked. seeing the PD autopage: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-98123

leo: oncall here, switching to incident channel. quick ask — any obvious config churn in the last 15m?

sara: nothing on infra deploys in the last 20m. I can tail the log topic for errors. running: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group ingest-main` now.

jamie: checking prometheus: `sum(increase(scrape_series_added[5m])) by (job)` -> 0 for metrics-ingest-exporter since 1768004200. looks like scrapes stopped.

leo: okay, possible exporter OOM or network blackhole. can someone run a quick curl to exporter endpoint from the scrape-proxy node?

sara: from scrape-proxy-3:
```
curl -sS http://10.3.14.56:9100/metrics | head -n 5
curl: (7) Failed to connect to 10.3.14.56 port 9100: Connection timed out
```

jamie: exporter not reachable. k8s shows exporter pod on metrics-ingest-exporter-7 crashed ~ 2m ago. `kubectl get pods -n ingest -o wide | grep exporter` -> CrashLoopBackOff.

incident-bot: pagerbot has created incident INC-98123 and escalated to rotation after 5m without ack from primary.

leo: I'll restart the pod and check evicted OOM logs. `kubectl logs metrics-ingest-exporter-7 -n ingest --previous` -> `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` + GC thrash.

sara: restarting with increased heap and bumping replicas to 3 for short-term. applying manifest patch now.

jamie: adjusting alerting temporarily: muting scrape-failure on metrics-ingest-exporter to avoid repeated pages, leaving kafka-lag alert live. :thumbsup:

oncall-rotation: confirmed restart applied. exporter pods are coming up, healthchecks green on 10.3.14.57 and .58. scrapes resuming.

jamie: prometheus now shows `increase(scrape_series_added[5m])` > 0, kafka lag trending down from 120k to 30k in last 10m. good.

customer-success-bot: PSA: initial customer-impact check — a small subset of customers on ingest-heavy plans may have missed metrics in their dashboards between 1768004200-1768005200. No downstream data loss reported; ingest backlog being processed. I'll draft an outbound note for impacted customers and queue for review.

leo: timeline summary for incident record:
- 1768004200: scrape windows started failing
- 1768004321: autopage (INC-98123) triggered
- 1768004400: oncall ack (leo)
- 1768004500: discovered exporter OOM
- 1768004560: pod restarted with increased heap and replicas
- 1768005200: scrapes resumed, backlog processing
- 1768005921: incident stabilized, monitoring

sara: suggested follow-ups: add JVM Xmx guardrails in helm chart, alert on exporter restart rate, enable heap-pressure mem metrics for earlier detection.

jamie: agree. also add a runbook note to check scrape-proxy network egress as a second hypothesis.

customer-success-bot: drafted customer note and will ping legal/ops for approval. tagging @jamie for technical blurb.

leo: closing this thread once customer note approved and postmortem scheduled. great quick ops, thanks everyone. :clap:
__meta_note: This document is a synthetic Slack thread representing an autopage for metrics ingestion failure and live mitigation. Messages are presented chronologically and formatted as a continuous Slack-style conversation.
